messages:
ops-bot: PAGING: runtime-us-east-2a reporting sustained GPU allocation failures and increased page faults on p4d-legacy cluster. Pager: @emma. Severity P2. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-memory-paging

emma: ack. joining. Observed spike across 3 nodes (runtime-ue2a-03/04/07). Collecting nvml, dmesg, runtime allocator histograms and kvcache metrics.

raj: support flagged 4 customers with transient errors and elevated tail latency. Two customers reported cancelled requests due to 10s+ stalls. Marking potential customer impact.

taylor: quick check: allocator reports many small pinned tensors and free region map shows many <16MB fragments; largest_free_chunk metric on nodes ~48MB only. Max contiguous needed for our default max_batch=24 ~= 1.2GiB for the model, so fragmentation likely.

bea: early hypothesis: kvcache pinned entries + pinned host pages from `cudaHostRegister` caused heavy fragmentation. Also saw a coincident large-batch burst from an internal canary job at ~02:18 UTC.

emma: mitigation plan executing now:
- reduce route.max_batch for heavy models in us-east-2a to 10
- apply kvcache.soft_cap=4096MB for the affected runtime pools
- restart runtime workers on the three nodes (rolling) to reclaim pinned allocations
- add temporary routing rule to route large requests to other regions if capacity available
Applying batch change and kvcache soft cap first.

ops-bot: CONFIG APPLY: route.text-gen-heavy.max_batch=10 (scope: us-east-2a) (change-id: ch-2098765432-1)

ops-bot: CONFIG APPLY: runtime.kvcache.soft_cap=4096MB (scope: p4d-legacy-us-east-2a) (change-id: ch-2098765432-2)

infra-bot: kvcache snapshot for runtime-ue2a-03 -> cap=12288MB used=11820MB entries=2893 pinned=1320 avg_entry=4.1MB largest_free_chunk=50MB slab_util=91%

raj: logs from runtime-ue2a-03 (excerpt):
```
[2026-07-21T02:17:58Z] nvml: ERROR cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (retry path)
[2026-07-21T02:17:59Z] runtime: allocator: try_alloc_contiguous(1234567890) -> failed, largest_free=52428800
[2026-07-21T02:18:02Z] runtime: kvcache: insert pinned entry id=0x7fbe size=3.9MB
[2026-07-21T02:18:05Z] kernel: NVRM: page fault on channel 0x1
```

bea: rolling restarts started at 02:18:30Z. Note: we saw the canary burst at 02:17:50Z which likely created the sudden demand for contiguous memory.

emma: enabling a temporary per-tenant concurrency cap on the heavy route to 1 (to avoid backpressure amplification). ops-bot to apply.

ops-bot: RUNTIME PATCH: routing.text-gen-heavy.per_tenant_concurrency=1 (scope: us-east-2a) (change-id: ch-2098765432-3)

infra-bot: metrics 02:19:45Z after kvcache soft cap & batch reduction: slab_util down -> 64% on runtime-ue2a-03, largest_free_chunk increased -> 340MB, nvml malloc failures dropped ~85% in the past 90s.

raj: customer impact update: CS notified. They confirmed transient retries and one cancelled job; no data lost. Draft message queued.

bea: artifacts uploaded: nvml_profiles.tar.gz, allocator_hist_02_20.json, dmesg_excerpt.log to https://internal.artifacts/incidents/2098765432/

taylor: notes for RCA collection:
- gather contiguous-free-region timeline (largest_free_chunk metric) across affected nodes from 02:10 -> 02:30 UTC
- correlate kvcache insert rates, pinned_count, and the canary job schedule
- capture a heap snapshot and kvcache key sample pre- and post-restart

emma: timeline in-thread so far:
- 02:17:50Z canary large-batch spike starts
- 02:17:58Z nvml cudaMalloc failures begin
- 02:18:06Z ops-bot alert triggers
- 02:18:30Z configuration changes (max_batch and kvcache soft cap) applied
- 02:18:45Z per-tenant concurrency cap applied
- 02:18:50Z rolling restarts begin
- 02:19:45Z metrics show stabilization (largest_free_chunk increasing, slab_util decreasing)

raj: adding explicit hypothesis tags in tracker: [fragmentation_contiguous_failure] [kvcache_pinned_growth] [burst_canary] [pinned_host_memory] [allocator_reorg_needed].

ops-bot: NOTE: scheduled follow-up meeting: incident-review-2098765432 at 15:00 UTC today. Please bring allocator histograms and any reproduction steps.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF -> next oncall @taylor at 03:00 UTC. Include remaining logs and any new regressions.

emma: post-incident mitigation wishlist (will be added to RFC):
- proactive kvcache eviction when contiguous largest_free_chunk < X (configurable)
- expose contiguous_free_chunk metric and alerting
- add ability for runtime to compact/defragment asynchronously or re-order allocations
- runtime allocator improvement: prefer small-block pools when pinned_count high
- prevent internal canaries from sending large-batch traffic to single region by default

bea: added ticket INF-5121 to implement contiguous_free_chunk monitoring and INF-5122 to add hotness-based kvcache eviction protective guard.

taylor: leaving this thread open for RCA artifacts and notes. Thanks for the quick coordination. :thumbsup:
